# Jacob Homanics

> Software engineer consultant for businesses, based in Austin, TX. Works hybrid and remote. Builds MVPs, turns vibe-coded projects into real products, modernizes legacy products, and manages and maintains existing products.

## What I build

Websites, mobile applications, video games, VR/AR applications, tooling solutions, smart contracts and blockchain technologies, built fast, secure, and scalable using the latest frameworks, technologies, and AI tools.

## Pricing

Open to hourly rates, task-based pricing, project-based pricing, and monthly retainers.

## Technologies

- AI tools: Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini
- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Node, C#, Solidity
- Frameworks: React, React Native, Vite, Next.js, Expo
- Backend and databases: Convex, Supabase, Prisma, MongoDB, PostgreSQL
- Hosting: Vercel, Cloudflare
